name: room-eval2-redo3: nine edits after the owner's third review (MOTH-106 to MOTH-112) and Claude's full consistency check, 25 Oct 2026
notes: Each approved wall edited with its one set of changes and the neighbour it must agree with attached. The specifications now carry a plan block (doors: hinge, swing, open angle, where the leaf lies; the floor pattern's direction; flat walls), checked by roomcheck.py (checklist 72 to 74).
The real charge lands in results and goes in the level file's ledger as re-dos.

cases.prompt: Attached picture 1 is this very wall, finished and approved. Redraw it as the same picture, keeping absolutely everything exactly as it is, the same objects in the same places at the same sizes, the same colours and light, except for these changes: (Attached picture 2 is the door wall of the same room, where this door hangs on the right-hand jamb and swings open toward this wall; match it.) (1) Mary's door: the open doorway is on the narrow left-hand side wall right at the back corner, a dark honey wood frame, and through it the corridor's opposite wall close behind it, plain white with a dark wood skirting board and stone tiles; the dark honey wooden door leaf is hinged at that back-left corner and stands fully open into the room, lying flat against the back wall at its far left, its handle at the leaf's right edge; the planets poster sits just to the right of the open leaf, not covered by it. (2) The striped rug stays as it is, stripes running away from the viewer. Keep the drawing's style exactly: a polished, finished illustration drawn for a game, clean dark-ink outlines, soft shading, paper grain, the same palette and light. No words or letters anywhere, no arrows, no border. The picture fills the whole 16:9 frame.
